title: juncus maritimus subsp. rigidus
intro: Juncus maritimus subsp. rigidus, commonly known as rigid sea rush, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Juncaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory and gastrointestinal issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which provide relief from symptoms such as congestion and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Juncus maritimus subsp. rigidus include its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote better sleep. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its antimicrobial, antispasmodic, and antitumor activities.
